messages:
elaine: FYI onboarding Pages template started failing after the export-map tidy. Deploy error: \"TypeError: RetryPolicy is undefined\" and editors show \"Could not find a declaration file for 'redwood-sdk'\".

jon: Can you paste the package.json exports from the template?

elaine: snippet:
```json\"exports\": {
  \"./*\": \"./dist/*\",
  \"./package.json\": \"./package.json\"
}```
No explicit top-level `.` export and no `types` field.

sam: Wildcard subpath mapping is the culprit. Cloudflare Pages is ESM-only so it hits the .mjs ESM bundle; our recent rollup output wraps exports as a default-only bundle, while the CJS build still had named exports. That explains the runtime mismatch and the missing types for editors.

jon: Quick fixes: add a top-level `"."` conditional export with `import` -> `./dist/index.mjs` and `require` -> `./dist/index.cjs`, and add `"types": "./dist/index.d.ts"` at package root. Also make the ESM build preserve named exports instead of default-wrapping.

sam: Long term: add CI smoke tests that install the built package into a pure-ESM sandbox (Pages/Bun/Deno) and run `tsc --noEmit` against onboarding templates. Also add a lint rule to flag `require()` usage in sample repos.

ci-bot: created issue RED-7001 and draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1422 (adds explicit `.` export, top-level types, and named-exports interop for ESM).

elaine: Temporary unblock in the template: `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'; const { RetryPolicy } = Redwood.default ?? Redwood;` ugly but works for Pages. I'll update onboarding notes and ping CS for affected signups.

jon: I'll land the PR once CI passes and update the starter templates to use the named import style after release. Thanks for the report.
